scope: Separate production hardware targets. This is a source/parameter manifest, not two implemented or calibrated vehicle physics packages.

xiaomi_product_live.scope: Current hardware descriptions; do not assume current software/trim equals 2025 launch calibration.

xiaomi_track_release_20250626.scope: Manufacturer release distinguishes base, optional track package and limited edition.

xiaomi_nurburgring_20250401.scope: Production record configuration only; prototype figures on same page excluded.

sharedPowertrainPolicy: Use evidence-backed three-motor architecture and limits. No evidence that ordinary track package adds motor power or independently proves different ECU gains.

production_air.tyrePolicy: Record actual tyre separately; suspension type does not identify tyre compound.

production_track_coilover.labelZh: 量产赛道专业套装绞牙版

hardware.springDamper: Bilstein EVO R for Ultra coilovers
hardware.compressionReboundAdjustment: 10-stage per official description; exact per-axle curve unknown

publishedEnvelopeOnly.use: Bounds only, not measured front/rear wheel rate or N*s/m damper coefficient.

production_track_coilover.tyrePolicy: Package includes two tyre types; record which is mounted and its temperature.

excludedConfigurations.nurburgring_record_car: Track package plus dual-vent carbon hood, aero underbody and certified safety modifications. Do not treat it as either ordinary baseline.
excludedConfigurations.nurburgring_limited_edition: Separate production equipment. Published 30 kg reduction is not an ordinary track-package mass delta.
excludedConfigurations.prototype: Different car; do not copy its slick tyres, springs, mass or downforce to production targets.

sourceMod.winglessSkins: Hide mesh nodes; no separate aero physics found.

existingExperiment.controlModePolicy: ECU experiment modes do not select air suspension or track coilover hardware.
existingExperiment.validUse: Controller comparisons on a hypothetical planar plant; no validated air-versus-coilover handling or lap-time prediction.
